mappings.summary: LangGraph crash recovery can duplicate an external side effect even though graph durability machinery is active.

evidence.excerpt: No exception is raised -- the failure is silent duplication of a node's side effects after crash recovery.
evidence.claim: Crash recovery state does not by itself prove the external side effect was executed exactly once.

mappings.caveat: This compares guarantees, not product scope; external effect confirmation may intentionally be application-owned.

declaration.limitations: Analyst-authored comparison against a pinned LangGraph code revision and the public #8039 failure report. It does not assert all LangGraph integrations lack stronger application-level guarantees.
